subject: Post-demo: HealCo security next steps & pentest timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Kapoor <anya.kapoor@healco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + security/compliance checklist (next actions)

Hi Anya — great to meet you and the HealCo team on today's demo. Thanks for the thoughtful questions about data controls and inference isolation. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize next steps and what we'll share to help your security and procurement teams evaluate Redwood.

1) SOC 2 status: we'll confirm our latest audit report and scope.
2) Regulatory posture: HIPAA / GDPR notes and data residency options we discussed.
3) Vendor security questionnaire: if you can share your intake spreadsheet (or a docx/xls), we'll map answers and return both short answers + evidence.
4) Pen test / vuln program: you asked for our most recent penetration test summary and details on our vulnerability management SLAs, scanning cadence, and disclosure policy — we can provide a summary and redact any sensitive third-party findings.

Please see attached a short security questionnaire we usually send (Redwood_Security_QS_v3.pdf) — if you prefer we populate your RFI instead, send it over and we'll start mapping.

Proposed timing:
- Monday (May 24): Redwood to return SOC 2 status and a one-page pentest summary.
- Wednesday (May 26): joint call with your security lead to walk the questionnaire mapping (30 min).

If those dates look good, we'll proceed. Quick ask: can you confirm whether HealCo requires HIPAA BAAs for this workload, or whether a DPIA/GDPR data flow diagram would be helpful?

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187
From: Anya Kapoor <anya.kapoor@healco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healco.com, procurement@healco.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + security/compliance checklist (next actions)

Thanks Rishi — really useful recap. A few quick items from our side: 

- SOC 2: HealCo needs a copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or an AOC) and the covered services list. If it's still in progress, a status and expected completion is fine.
- HIPAA / GDPR: This workload will process PHI for a pilot (consented clinical data), so a BAA will be necessary if we move forward.
- Vendor questionnaire: I'm attaching our intake spreadsheet (HealCo_RFI_v1.xlsx). Please populate columns A-F and point us to evidence links where available.
- Pen test: We expect a pen test summary (high-level findings and remediation status) — full raw reports can be redacted. Also share your vulnerability SLA and how you handle critical findings (timeline to remediate/mitigate, responsible parties).

I cc'd our security mailbox and procurement to keep them looped.

Would Monday 24th for your deliverables and Wednesday 26th for a quick walk-through work? If yes we'll get a calendar invite out.

Best,
Anya

--
Anya Kapoor
Head of IT Security | HealCo
anya.kapoor@healco.com | +1 212-555-0102

- Rishi: SOC 2 status — we should provide the AOC + scope doc. Ops will allow redacted pendings but let's confirm date.
- Steph: could you assemble the pentest one-pager and ensure the timeline for CVSS >=9 is clear (our SLA commitment). Also include the cadence for authenticated weekly scans vs. quarterly full pentests.
- I'll prepare the vendor questionnaire mapping template and a Drive folder link for evidence items.

I'll start the Drive folder and share with Anya once Steph's doc is ready. Target Monday EOD for the packet leaving our side.

Thanks — Marcus

Anya — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Attached are the artifacts we discussed: Redwood_Pentest_Summary_202606.pdf (redacted executive summary of our last third-party pen test), and Redwood_Vuln_Process_SLA.md (our documented SLA and remediation timelines). We also populated your HealCo_RFI_v1.xlsx and uploaded evidence links to the Drive folder below.

Key points from the pentest summary and vuln SLA: 
- Pen test cadence: full third-party pen test annually; targeted application/network assessments after major releases or every 6 months for critical infra.
- Scanning cadence: authenticated vulnerability scans weekly for infra, daily internal pipeline scans for high-risk components.
- SLA for critical/9.0+ findings: initial acknowledgment within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours, temporary compensating controls or rollback if exploit risk persists.
- Disclosure: we share executive summaries publicly, full reports only under NDA/BAA with redaction for customer-specific findings or third-party plugin details.

Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwoodVendorQAs
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/HL-1932

We also noted BAA requirement — happy to have legal start a draft BAA and loop procurement. If you'd like, we can join a 30-minute call on Wed 26th at 10am EDT to walk the RFI answers and go over the remediation timelines.

Best,
Rishi
